In this notebook, I will take the Z score data from the HuProt analysis (which is in wide format) and convert it to a long format. I will also add additional metadata to the file before outputting.

# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringi)
```

# HuProt Data

## Load

```{r}
hits.wide <- read_csv("data/huprot/Regeneron_90_RawLog2MFI_ZScore_Hits_635nm_red.csv")
hits.wide
```

## Convert to Long

```{r}
hits.wide.renamed <- hits.wide %>% 
  select(-Block, -Column, -Rows, -anti_gst) %>% 
  separate(col = Name, into =  c("Gene", "UniProt"), sep = "\\|", ) 

hits.wide.renamed
```

Let's confirm that the errors are expected

```{r}
hits.wide[c(632, 21997, 22970, 22972, 22979, 22985, 22994, 22996, 23002, 23008, 23017, 23029, 23030, 23031, 23032, 23033, 23034, 23035, 23036, 23037, 23038:23059),]
```

"\xa0" indicates a space, which is in the original input file for entries 633 ("FLJ11939 |NA") and 22072 ("PCDHGC3 |NA").

The rest of the NA rows are true NA, where there is not a corresponding UniProt identifier (and no separating "|")

```{r}
hits.wide.renamed %>% filter(ID %in% c("JHU03316.B1C4R50", "JHU03126.B19C15R14"))
```


```{r}
hits.wide.renamed[c(632, 21997),]

hits.wide.renamed <- hits.wide.renamed %>% 
  mutate(Gene = ifelse(ID == "JHU03316.B1C4R50", "FLJ11939", Gene)) %>% 
  mutate(Gene = ifelse(ID == "JHU03126.B19C15R14", "PCDHGC3", Gene))

hits.wide.renamed[c(632, 21997),]
```



```{r}
hits.long <- hits.wide.renamed %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(-Gene, -UniProt, -ID), names_to = "cdi_id", values_to = "zscore")

hits.long
```

```{r}
write_csv(hits.long, "out/huprot/huprot_zscorehits_igg.csv")
```
